decisions.reason: The margin analysis draws on the firm's core market-data assets, has its own web page and fits the announced platform strategy, so management keeps it and treats any slow uptake as a temporary ramp-up.
With the broader gas and energy tariff tools withdrawn, the electricity tariff calculator is the firm's main visible regional tariff tool, and its sunk costs and platform role justify keeping it.
The area definition tool supports the remaining location-based products and the central platform, so management continues to back it.

This line overlaps with tariff tools the firm has already pruned and has only modest web visibility, but the investment in several models and its closeness to the core business still tip the decision toward keeping it.
